idea-plugin.name: Sage for Copilot Chat
idea-plugin.description:
Sage analyses your GitHub Copilot chat sessions (from both the IDE Copilot panel and the copilot CLI) to find mistakes and turn them into lasting project or global Copilot instructions, so future sessions stop repeating them.

  • Seek Enlightenment — multi-select one or more chat sessions, analyse them with the installed copilot CLI, and merge the resulting lessons into .github/copilot-instructions.md, ~/.copilot/instructions/learnings.instructions.md, or both. Choose between Conservative (minimal, evidence-backed edits) and Aggressive (broader rewrites/removals) learning modes, and optionally pick a model.
  • Preserve the Holy Texts — export any IDE or CLI chat session to a readable Markdown file, including thinking blocks and tool calls, with a searchable session picker and a "Reveal in Explorer" shortcut.

Configurable via Settings → Sage (default export folder, content toggles). Learning scope, mode, and model are chosen in the "Analyse Copilot Sessions" dialog and remembered as defaults for next time. Requires the copilot CLI on PATH (or SAGE_CLI_PATH) and an active GitHub Copilot subscription for the learning feature.

action.description: Analyse Copilot chat sessions for mistakes and update instructions files, or export a session to Markdown
